name: cache-lamp
description: A lamp above the prompt box showing the state of the session's prompt cache, and a quiet ping that keeps a big cache warm while you are away.

bigTokens.title: Big session, in tokens
bigTokens.description: A session with at least this many tokens of context counts as big: the lamp warns about it and it can be kept warm.

keepWarmHours.title: Keep warm for, hours
keepWarmHours.description: How many hours after your last own prompt a big session is kept warm.

compactHint.title: Red size from, in tokens
compactHint.description: From this much context the lamp line draws the session's size red: time to /compact by hand. 0 turns it off.

language.title: Interface language
language.description: Language of the lamp's own words: auto follows the system language, or pick en or ru.
